label: D2 after a2 led rarely to S1, following an unrewarded trial (late episode)
explanation: Fires only at D2 (never D1/GO), and almost only when the agent chose a2 and the rare transition took it to S1 (93% of mass); in_action=2 and in_state=1 at that step. It needs the previous trial to be unrewarded (prev_reward==0 carries 97% of mass) and is gated by time in episode: silent before trial ~20, rising steadily to a peak around trials 70-89. Magnitude grows over runs of consecutive unrewarded a2->S1 rare trials (about 0.2 -> 0.7 -> 0.9 of max in the top windows), so it looks like an accumulating evidence trace that a2 keeps leading to an unrewarded S1. Weak activations also occur on a2->S2 common D2 steps right after such runs. Does not fire after a1 choices, on S2 states in general, or after rewarded trials. All variables are observable at D2 (action and state are inputs then); no future variables used. Dev F1 0.74, mass recall 0.89; the ep_trial threshold is a proxy for a slow within-episode drift, and the many false positives are mostly isolated rare-unrewarded a2 trials not preceded by other unrewarded trials.
